visual_brief.subject: Rescale puts an MCP-backed test-triage agent into its release gate
verified_context: Rescale runs a production agent inside an Argo workflow to classify nightly Playwright failures and retrieve supporting operational evidence.
The agent queries CloudWatch logs through MCP and produces structured remediation reports for human review before production changes.
visual_brief.editorial_idea: Show automated sorting and evidence gathering ending at a separate human-controlled release gate.
visual_brief.visual_metaphor: sorted failure channels, a terracotta evidence tray and a guarded release gate
must_show: sorted failure channels, a terracotta evidence tray and a guarded release gate

candidate_notes.A: Selected: three distinct queues, a tangible evidence tray and a separate gate preserve the human-control boundary at small size.
candidate_notes.B: The four-channel sorting court is clear but reads more like a schematic and gives the reviewer less visual presence.
candidate_notes.C: The library metaphor is too literal and contains pseudo-text-like marks on papers, so it was rejected from publication.

crop_review.article_desktop: The incoming queues, evidence tray and guarded gate all remain in the wide crop.
crop_review.article_mobile: The evidence tray and gate remain together in the center-right crop.
crop_review.thumbnail: The terracotta tray and large gate form a strong paired silhouette.

golden_reference_comparison: Compared with the two declared repository references for warm paper texture, restrained stone materiality, sparing terracotta emphasis, physical depth and thumbnail legibility. Candidate A was selected after full-size and small-size visual inspection.

generation_metadata.visual_review: Three candidates generated per story. Candidate A was inspected at full size and thumbnail scale; cover-crop safety and prohibited elements were reviewed by Codex model self-review. Candidate C for the Rescale story was rejected for pseudo-text-like paper marks.
